name: Winterhoof Water Well
summary: At Winterhoof Water Well, the Venture Company threatens Mulgore's water supply. The well lies south of Bloodhoof Village, at the edge of the Rolling Plains, where tauren tribes and roaming herds depend on its fresh water.

sections.title: A Threatened Lifeline
sections.body: Water from deep wells sustains Mulgore's herds and tauren encampments. Winterhoof Water Well draws from aquifers beneath the Rolling Plains and bears the name of one of the plains' respected tribes. Now the Venture Company has targeted this vital source. The goblin cartel has tried to poison the water and gain control over the surrounding territory.

sections.title: Purification and Defense
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn has made sacred totems to counter the Venture Company's toxins and restore the well's balance. The tauren's young braves must help cleanse it. For the tauren, protecting the well is both a matter of survival and a duty to keep the earth and its waters free from corruption.

faq.q: Where is the Winterhoof Water Well located?
faq.answer: Winterhoof Water Well lies in southern Mulgore, south of Bloodhoof Village at the edge of the Rolling Plains.

faq.q: Who poisoned the Winterhoof Water Well?
faq.answer: The Venture Company poisoned Winterhoof Water Well to control local resources and weaken the tauren.

faq.q: How can the poisoned well be cleansed?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn crafted an enchanted totem whose primal magic purges the Venture Company's toxins from the water.

faq.q: Why are water wells so sacred to the tauren?
aliases: why do tauren care about wells
faq.answer: Tauren rely on water for their tribes and roaming herds, and see it as a gift from the Earth Mother. Poisoning it threatens their lives and offends their faith.

angles.text: As a tauren, defending and purifying ancestral water wells is among the first trials young braves face as they protect the land from outside exploitation.
As a shaman, cleansing the well calls for elemental harmony and shows how totems can heal wounded water spirits.
